entries.definition: Policy separating regions inside one allocated teaching arena.

edition_notes.note: This laboratory abstraction is a program contract; ISO C does not enforce its lifecycle or target-specific obligations.

distinguish_from.distinction: The language object may encompass several logical regions.

idiom: logical arena isolation requires an explicit contract.
entries.misconception: Repair capacity confusion and post-write checks. A canary that detects corruption afterward does not restore overwritten data or authorize the write.

recall.define: Define logical arena isolation with its invariant.
recall.distinguish: Distinguish logical arena isolation from C object bounds.
recall.counterexample: Split the logical object into a real heap allocation and run the isolated faulty path under ASan; compare deterministic model evidence with environment-dependent undefined execution and mitigation effects.

entries.definition: Observable target-local sentinel change demonstrating the specified violation.

edition_notes.note: This laboratory abstraction is a program contract; ISO C does not enforce its lifecycle or target-specific obligations.

distinguish_from.distinction: A data sentinel does not establish control of instruction execution.

recall.define: Define harmless integrity witness with its invariant.
recall.distinguish: Distinguish harmless integrity witness from code execution proof.
recall.counterexample: Split the logical object into a real heap allocation and run the isolated faulty path under ASan; compare deterministic model evidence with environment-dependent undefined execution and mitigation effects.

entries.definition: Disagreement between bytes reserved and bytes subsequently accessed for one request.

edition_notes.note: This laboratory abstraction is a program contract; ISO C does not enforce its lifecycle or target-specific obligations.

distinguish_from.distinction: A successful small allocation can still be insufficient.

idiom: allocation-access extent mismatch requires an explicit contract.
entries.misconception: The original local mutant requests8193 elements of8 bytes, validates a truncated8-byte allocation and would later copy65544 bytes. Demonstrate the admitted size mismatch without performing the dangerous copy.

recall.define: Define allocation-access extent mismatch with its invariant.
recall.distinguish: Distinguish allocation-access extent mismatch from allocation failure.
recall.counterexample: Change data model and add alignment/header overhead; rederive all multiplication/addition/conversion bounds and explain whether the same attacker input still reaches the defect.

entries.definition: Conversion that discards information used by an admission decision.

edition_notes.note: This laboratory abstraction is a program contract; ISO C does not enforce its lifecycle or target-specific obligations.

distinguish_from.distinction: Truncation is safe only under a proved range or deliberate contract.

idiom: security-relevant narrowing requires an explicit contract.
entries.misconception: The original local mutant requests8193 elements of8 bytes, validates a truncated8-byte allocation and would later copy65544 bytes. Demonstrate the admitted size mismatch without performing the dangerous copy.

recall.define: Define security-relevant narrowing with its invariant.
recall.distinguish: Distinguish security-relevant narrowing from harmless truncation.
recall.counterexample: Change data model and add alignment/header overhead; rederive all multiplication/addition/conversion bounds and explain whether the same attacker input still reaches the defect.

entries.definition: Token referring to a previous occupant of reused teaching storage.

edition_notes.note: This laboratory abstraction is a program contract; ISO C does not enforce its lifecycle or target-specific obligations.

distinguish_from.distinction: Equal storage address does not imply equal object lifetime.

idiom: stale arena identity requires an explicit contract.
entries.misconception: The mutant ignores generation and reveals a new occupant’s synthetic byte through an old token. This demonstrates a confidentiality violation in the target, not a read primitive against another process.

recall.define: Define stale arena identity with its invariant.
recall.distinguish: Distinguish stale arena identity from same address.
recall.counterexample: Add asynchronous completion retaining a token, then release/reuse the slot before completion. Design cancellation and retirement so old callbacks cannot expose the new occupant.

entries.definition: Validation that an access belongs to the current live incarnation.

edition_notes.note: This laboratory abstraction is a program contract; ISO C does not enforce its lifecycle or target-specific obligations.

distinguish_from.distinction: An in-range offset can still refer to the wrong object.

idiom: temporal access admission requires an explicit contract.
entries.misconception: The mutant ignores generation and reveals a new occupant’s synthetic byte through an old token. This demonstrates a confidentiality violation in the target, not a read primitive against another process.

recall.define: Define temporal access admission with its invariant.
recall.distinguish: Distinguish temporal access admission from spatial bound.
recall.counterexample: Add asynchronous completion retaining a token, then release/reuse the slot before completion. Design cancellation and retirement so old callbacks cannot expose the new occupant.

entries.definition: Borrowed span admitted by ownership, incarnation and extent checks.

edition_notes.note: This laboratory abstraction is a program contract; ISO C does not enforce its lifecycle or target-specific obligations.

distinguish_from.distinction: A bounded pointer need not carry access authority.

idiom: authorized arena view requires an explicit contract.
entries.misconception: The mutant validates generation and bounds but ignores principal ownership. The attacker can read another synthetic principal’s object without any memory error or sanitizer report.

recall.define: Define authorized arena view with its invariant.
recall.distinguish: Distinguish authorized arena view from bounded pointer.
recall.counterexample: Compare the C view with a language-enforced borrow or capability mechanism; provide a concrete C counterexample showing forged structs or escaped pointers defeat an overstated equivalence claim.

entries.definition: Mechanism supplying caller identity independently of attacker-controlled request bytes.

edition_notes.note: This laboratory abstraction is a program contract; ISO C does not enforce its lifecycle or target-specific obligations.

distinguish_from.distinction: A request can assert an identity without proving it.

idiom: trusted principal channel requires an explicit contract.
entries.misconception: The mutant validates generation and bounds but ignores principal ownership. The attacker can read another synthetic principal’s object without any memory error or sanitizer report.

recall.define: Define trusted principal channel with its invariant.
recall.distinguish: Distinguish trusted principal channel from claimed owner field.
recall.counterexample: Compare the C view with a language-enforced borrow or capability mechanism; provide a concrete C counterexample showing forged structs or escaped pointers defeat an overstated equivalence claim.

entries.definition: Harmless selected action proving a bounded dispatch-property violation.

edition_notes.note: This laboratory abstraction is a program contract; ISO C does not enforce its lifecycle or target-specific obligations.

distinguish_from.distinction: The witness does not establish an unrestricted instruction primitive.

idiom: target-local action witness requires an explicit contract.

recall.define: Define target-local action witness with its invariant.
recall.distinguish: Distinguish target-local action witness from arbitrary code execution.
recall.counterexample: Add a table of three trusted callbacks and a corrupted index inside the original program; compare range checks, read-only dispatch tables and compiler CFI while recording only observed target effects.

entries.definition: Allowed call edge whose operation is unauthorized for the caller.

edition_notes.note: This laboratory abstraction is a program contract; ISO C does not enforce its lifecycle or target-specific obligations.

distinguish_from.distinction: The target may be structurally valid but semantically forbidden.

idiom: control-flow authorization gap requires an explicit contract.

recall.define: Define control-flow authorization gap with its invariant.
recall.distinguish: Distinguish control-flow authorization gap from invalid indirect target.
recall.counterexample: Add a table of three trusted callbacks and a corrupted index inside the original program; compare range checks, read-only dispatch tables and compiler CFI while recording only observed target effects.

entries.definition: Ability to choose interpreter directives in a formatted-output call.

edition_notes.note: This laboratory abstraction is a program contract; ISO C does not enforce its lifecycle or target-specific obligations.

distinguish_from.distinction: Text should remain data when supplied by an untrusted caller.

idiom: format authority requires an explicit contract.
entries.misconception: Blindly replacing percent with a question mark suppresses the witness but corrupts the required logged bytes. The real repair separates interpreter control from untrusted data.

recall.define: Define format authority with its invariant.
recall.distinguish: Distinguish format authority from text payload.
recall.counterexample: Add structured binary logging with explicit length and escaping at display time; test embedded NUL and terminal-control bytes without confusing storage fidelity with safe rendering.

entries.definition: Requirement that stored payload bytes match admitted input exactly.

edition_notes.note: This laboratory abstraction is a program contract; ISO C does not enforce its lifecycle or target-specific obligations.

distinguish_from.distinction: Safe rendering can transform presentation while retaining original bytes.

idiom: byte-preserving log contract requires an explicit contract.

recall.define: Define byte-preserving log contract with its invariant.
recall.distinguish: Distinguish byte-preserving log contract from display escaping.
recall.counterexample: Add structured binary logging with explicit length and escaping at display time; test embedded NUL and terminal-control bytes without confusing storage fidelity with safe rendering.

entries.definition: Duty held by one owner to perform a resource’s terminal cleanup.

edition_notes.note: This laboratory abstraction is a program contract; ISO C does not enforce its lifecycle or target-specific obligations.

distinguish_from.distinction: An address copy does not determine who must release.

idiom: release obligation requires an explicit contract.
entries.misconception: The faulty cleanup path releases twice after ownership moved to a callback. Demonstrate the duplicate counter first, then separately observe an actual original double-free target under ASan.

recall.define: Define release obligation with its invariant.
recall.distinguish: Distinguish release obligation from nonnull alias.
recall.counterexample: Introduce reentrant destruction and partial object construction; define callback restrictions or use detached cleanup state so recursive calls cannot double release.

entries.definition: Accounting for acquired and transferred resources at each failure point.

edition_notes.note: This laboratory abstraction is a program contract; ISO C does not enforce its lifecycle or target-specific obligations.

distinguish_from.distinction: Success alone does not exercise error cleanup.

idiom: cleanup-prefix analysis requires an explicit contract.

recall.distinguish: Distinguish cleanup-prefix analysis from single success trace.
recall.counterexample: Introduce reentrant destruction and partial object construction; define callback restrictions or use detached cleanup state so recursive calls cannot double release.

edition_notes.note: This laboratory abstraction is a program contract; ISO C does not enforce its lifecycle or target-specific obligations.

recall.distinguish: Distinguish comparison work leakage from memory violation.
recall.counterexample: Change optimization, vectorization and unequal-length policy; derive what remains observable and compare hardened library behavior only as an external benchmark, not a replacement for the first-principles implementation.

recall.distinguish: For Memory safety offense and defense in original teaching programs, distinguish these near concepts: logical arena isolation versus C object bounds; harmless integrity witness versus code execution proof; allocation-access extent mismatch versus allocation failure; security-relevant narrowing versus harmless truncation; stale arena identity versus same address; temporal access admission versus spatial bound; authorized arena view versus bounded pointer; trusted principal channel versus claimed owner field; target-local action witness versus arbitrary code execution; control-flow authorization gap versus invalid indirect target; format authority versus text payload; byte-preserving log contract versus display escaping; release obligation versus nonnull alias; cleanup-prefix analysis versus single success trace; comparison work leakage versus memory violation; constant-time evidence scope versus source loop count.
